# Jayant Khanna

> Software engineer from India. Founding Engineer at Roomrr (https://roomrr.com), former Data Engineer at Genpact (Feb 2024 – Dec 2026), and a freelance Python, Django, React and Generative AI developer since 2021: 29 live websites for 13 clients.

## Services (freelance)

- Python and Django backend development (Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL)
- Full-stack web development (React, Node.js)
- Mobile app development (React Native)
- Generative AI and automation: RAG search, LLM apps, chat bots, workflow automation
- Data engineering: PySpark, Databricks, ETL and data-quality pipelines

## Experience

- Roomrr: Founding Engineer, full-time (2026 – present). Started as a freelance client.
- Genpact: Data Engineer, full-time (Feb 2024 – Dec 2026)
- Freelance Software Engineer (2021 – present): mobile Employee ERP, full-stack apps and automation bots, Generative AI for healthcare, Python APIs and connectors, e-commerce front end.

Education: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering, Graphic Era Deemed University (2020 – 2024).
